description: Before a consequential action, ask whether the user's rules auto-approve it. Returns auto_approve, needs_approval (with a plain-English approval card and a link the user can tap) or deny. Free plan is watch-only: it reports what it WOULD decide and logs it for the weekly report, but nothing counts as approved, so ask your user as you normally would.

action.description: The action your agent wants to take.

summary.description: One plain sentence of what will happen, e.g. "Buy a $3.99 domain renewal for example.com".

target.description: Who or what it touches: a recipient email, domain, file, repo.

type.description: Short verb: read, search, draft, send_email, send_message, post, purchase, payment, delete, deploy, change_settings, ...

name: check_action
